fields.explanation_for_circumstantiality: This gadget improves the brawler's overall survivability and damage output. However, this ability becomes much less efficient, almost useless, if many enemies deal damage in multiple projectiles, just as it becomes more efficient if many enemies deal massive damage with single projectiles.
Some of this brawler's abilities are only available on maps with water.
This star-power improves the brawler's mobility. However, it becomes absolutely useless in maps without centralized water.
This gadget improves the brawler's survivability. However, it relies on walls and strategic use to maximize its healing potential.
This star-power improves the brawler's mobility. However, it only happens when the brawler's hp is low, becoming less useful against brawlers with wide attacks or long ranges.
This star-power improves the brawler's survivability. However, that depends a lot on the context and needs long preparation.
This star-power improves the brawler's damage. However, it requires a very specific context and use.
This gadget improves the brawler's survivability by intercepting shots. However, it doesn't work with all types of projectiles.
This star-power improves the brawler's survivability and damage. However, that only happens for a few moments after defeating an enemy.

This gadget improves the brawler's survivability by restoring their HP after a certain amount of time. However, this ability becomes quite ineffective if their enemies have a lot of burst damage or abilities that cancel the cooldown.
This gadget improves the brawler's ability to create cover. However, it only works under specific circumstances (proximity to destroyed walls/bushes).

This star-power improves the brawler's survivability. However, that only happens after defeating an enemy, and also works better in matches where it's easier for Mortis to defeat enemies and harder for enemies to kill him.
Some of this brawler's abilities are only available on maps with water and grass.
This gadget can be used in a variety of ways. However, you need to choose between multiple uses for it and never have all benefits of it in a single use
Some of this brawler's abilities are only available on maps with water.
This gadget improves the brawler's survivability. However, that depends a lot on the context and needs long preparation.
This gadget improves the brawler's survivability. However, some brawlers with high mobility, long ranges and debuffers can take advantage of your totem, what would make the gadget a lot more limited.
This hipercharge, when used with a super, can charge allies's supers, what is not accounted in this software by now.
